(a) A solar panel receives energy from the Sun at a rate of 5.0 kW.
Thermal energy is transferred from the solar panel to water with an efficiency of 20%.
Cold water of mass 15 kg enters the solar panel every hour.
The specific heat capacity of water is 4200 J / (kg °C).
Calculate the temperature increase of the water.
temperature increase =  .....................................................°C [4]

mark_scheme.label: 3(a)
mark_scheme.text:
E = mcΔT in any form OR (E =) mcΔT
efficiency = (energy) output / (energy) input in any form
15 × 4200 × ΔT = 5000 × 3600 × 0.2
(ΔT = 5000 × 3600 × 0.2 / 15 × 4200 =) 57 °C
